# ChartBarStyle

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Explicit settings override the theme, including a corner radius of zero.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ChartBarStyle(options?: ChartBarStyleOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`cornerRadius`](#cornerradius): Value-end radius in points.
- [`gradient`](#gradient): Optional opaque fill, resolved into absolute coordinates before drawing.

### `cornerRadius`

```typescript
cornerRadius?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Value-end radius in points. Undefined uses the theme default; zero keeps square ends.

### `gradient`

```typescript
gradient: ChartLinearGradient | undefined
```

Optional opaque fill, resolved into absolute coordinates before drawing.
